answer.summary: The BOM Override Guard step failed in 'Resolve the runtime classpath' because Maven could not find the 'dependency' plugin prefix. The log says it searched only the local repo (/home/runner/.m2/reposito...), so the plugin was likely not available from the runner's cache or network. The change only touches openaev-front test files, so it is unlikely to be the cause. The log does not show whether the runner was offline or whether the plugin is pinned in the action, so confidence is moderate.
